versions.content: The CanIf shall guarantee data consistency of the CanId in case of running function CanIf_SetDynamicTxId() . This service may be in- terrupted by a pre-emptive call of CanIf_Transmit() affecting the same L-PDU, see [SWS_CANIF_00064].
